sentences.translation: # It's Uminota.
That's an eight-year-old boy.
I'm going to the sea with my grandmother today.
"It's a nice day," said he.
"Yes, I'm in the sun," said the grandma.
They held hands and walked to the sea.
I heard the sound of the sea.
Swallow and swab.
When I reached the sea, the waves came at my feet.
There is something glittering on the sand.
it's a shell!
"Grandma, there was a big shell!"
he said in a loud voice, with joy.
"Hey, there's a little sea bream here," said the Grandma.
"It's beautiful!"
and she picked up the shell, as she walked slowly on the sand.
Large shells, small shells, rounded two-shell shells.
There are various shellfish.
"How many have I picked up, I'll take a look at it?"
and counted, putting the shells in the basket.
"One, you, Mr....jugo! fifteen!"
"You picked it up a lot," said the grandma.
"Yes! It's sparkling, it's like a snail!"
The shells glittered with the sunshine.
As they turned around, they sat on the sand.
The grandmother gave out a bento from her bag.
"I'm having a bun today," said the grandma.
"Wow, it's big!"
"Let's rub half a bun of bread,"
She cut the bread in half and I did it.
They ate bread with a good taste.
"The bread is very big," said he.
"Yes, but if you eat it with them, it's perfect."
The rice I ate while watching the sea was very delicious.
I was glad to hear the sound of the waves.
"I'm sorry for the food. You ate a whole bowl of bread!"
"Good, shall we go?"
Before he could make a snail, he picked up a little more shellfish.
It's full of shells, pockets and bags.
When she got home, she said,
"Let's make it in the afternoon!"
"I love it!"
That's the end of the work.
Every summer, I look forward to working with my grandmother.
Whenever I do a work, my eyes glitter.
The grandma put the tools on the workbench.
Bonds, scissors, yarns, white plates, frames, and the shellfish you picked up.
"First, let's make a plate of shellfish," said the grandma.
"On the white plate, you'll be swooping on the shell."
and he put the little shells around the plate.
The largest shell was in the middle of the dish.
"It's beautiful to put a big shell in the middle," said he.
"Yes, the center is the most prominent."
It's a little bit of a snail.
The shells are covered with bonds.
The white dishes were getting cleaner and cleaner.
"Oh, sir! A plate of shellfish, a dish!"
said the grandma, smiling.
"You've done well,"
"Let's make a frame next," said the grandma.
"The work is wonderful!"
Around the frame, the shells are swept up.
Small shells, large shells, various shapes of shellfish.
The most beautiful shell was in the middle of the frame.
"This is the center!" said he.
The grandma smiled.
`I'm so sorry I can't do it!'
"Let's make a mob."
Place the shells on the thread and hang from top to bottom.
A wooden pot is shruged with yarn.
When the shells are swayed, it glitters.
"Wow, it's beautiful!"
Three works were completed completely.
Shellfish dishes, frames, mobils.
Three works are completed!
They looked at the work, smiling.
"I'll give you a plate of shellfish," said he.
"The frame is to the father,"
The grandma smiled.
"You're kind, sir,"
In the evening, my mother and father came home.
"Today, I picked up a shell in the sea! And I did it!"
"Wow!" said the mother.
"The plate is beautiful. There's a big shell in the middle, and it's nice!"
My mother was very happy.
I felt warm.
Today was a very good day, picking up a lot of shellfish in the sea and making crafts.
"The things from the sea bream" were not only for shellfish, but also for the time of the grandmother.
sigh
